extDesc.message: Smart text assistant powered by Mistral AI

optionsIntro.message: Configure API access, writing style and appearance.

visualStyleHint.message: Changes the modal, menus, popup, and suggestion appearance.

customCommandsIntro.message: Create your own actions. They will appear in the LexiSync selection menu.

glossaryHint.message: Use one “source term = translation” pair per line. The glossary stays on this device.

styleProfilesIntro.message: Create instructions for work email, chats, or publications.

profileSitesHint.message: Enter one domain per line. The profile is selected automatically for the domain and its subdomains.

portableSettingsHint.message: The API key, history, statistics, and local language model are never included.

historyEmpty.message: History is empty. Successful results will appear here.

confirmClearHistory.message: Delete the entire request history? This cannot be undone.

historyCommandSaved.message: The command was saved in settings.

requestConnectionLost.message: The request connection was interrupted. Try again.

allSitesAccessEnable.message: Allow on all websites and embedded frames

allSitesAccessHint.message: LexiSync will be automatically active in all online editors, learning platforms (Stepik, Coursera), and documents without having to enable each domain individually.

commandNotFound.message: The original custom command was not found.

toggleApiKey.message: Show or hide the API key

appearanceHint.message: Scale applies to the selection toolbar, AI menu, and result window.

compactResultModeHint.message: Show only the finished text and replace and copy buttons.

sendContextHint.message: When enabled, up to 2,000 surrounding characters, the page title, and domain are sent with the selection. Disabled by default.

suggestionsHint.message: LexiSync shows up to three options near the field. Use arrows to navigate, Tab or Enter to accept, and Esc to close.

learningHint.message: Words and phrases stay on this device. Passwords, payment fields, private windows, and excluded sites are ignored.

historyPrivateHint.message: History and cache are always disabled in private windows.

getApiKeyStep2.message: Find API Keys in the left menu.

onboardingIntro.message: The extension corrects, translates, and improves text directly on the page.

onboardingOpen.message: Click the LexiSync button next to the selection

onboardingShortcutsHint.message: Core actions work without opening a menu.

onboardingPrivacyHint.message: Text is sent to Mistral only to run the AI command you choose.

onboardingApiHint.message: The key is required for AI commands and stays in the extension's local storage.

tabGuideMainDescription.message: Connect Mistral, choose a writing tone, and select a search engine.

tabGuideAiDescription.message: Choose a model and configure your glossary, style profiles, and request limits.

tabGuideAppearanceDescription.message: Adjust the theme, window style, interface size, density, and transparency.

tabGuideSuggestionsDescription.message: Control local suggestions and automatic text proofreading.

tabGuidePrivacyDescription.message: Choose what to save, which sites to exclude, and when page context may be sent.

tabGuideCommandsDescription.message: Create simple commands for text tasks you repeat often.

apiKeySimpleHint.message: Used only for AI commands. Your key is stored locally and cannot be accessed by websites.

toneSimpleHint.message: Used when improving or rewriting text. Translation and error correction are unchanged.

searchEngineSimpleHint.message: Opens when you choose the command to search the web for selected text.

refinePolitePrompt.message: Rewrite the text in a polite, diplomatic, and friendly tone.

refineSimplePrompt.message: Rewrite the text using clear, simple language without corporate jargon.

historyPromptSummary.message: Create a structured and concise summary of the text (TL;DR) with key takeaways.

refineAgreePrompt.message: Rewrite the reply in a tone of agreement, readiness, and confirmation.

refineDeclinePrompt.message: Rewrite the reply in a tone of polite, tactful, and reasoned decline.

refineClarifyPrompt.message: Rewrite the reply politely asking to clarify key details, requirements, or deadlines.

refineAlternativePrompt.message: Rewrite the reply proposing a convenient alternative or different time.

refineSimplerPrompt.message: Explain in even simpler terms using everyday analogies without jargon.

refineExamplesPrompt.message: Add clear practical real-life examples of usage.
